title: Reassuring self-worth affirmations
description: This latent fires on formulaic, therapeutic-style affirmations that directly address 'you' with validating statements about deserving happiness, respect, love, or well-being, and imperative encouragements to prioritize self-care, healing, or boundary-setting. It activates most strongly on short, template-like phrases such as 'You deserve to be...', 'Remember, you deserve...', 'Take care of yourself and prioritize your own...', and 'Keep...' that read like closing lines of advice-column or chatbot responses offering comfort and permission for self-focus. It is weaker or inactive on sentences that give situational analysis, ask questions, list numbered options, or discuss the other person's behavior/motives, even if they occur in the same supportive advice-giving context, since the latent specifically tracks the direct affirming/validating address to the reader rather than general relationship advice or reasoning.
